description: This Java source file contains utility methods for working with maps, including functions to find the closest key to a given value, retrieve or create map entries, and parse integers with error handling.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static helper methods for map operations and integer parsing.

methods.name: findClosest
methods.description: Finds the key in the provided TreeMap that is closest to the specified integer value.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the map for a given key, or creates and inserts a new value using the provided Factory if the key is absent.

methods.name: parseIntWithReason
methods.description: Parses a string into an integer, throwing an exception with a custom reason if parsing fails.
